title: DatasetManifestV1
description: Normative I-20 contract (WP-10 / C-15): private dataset/subset/split/leakage and rights lineage manifest for IO-VNBD-class ingestion. Records only hashes and structural metadata -- never raw private bytes. See docs/architecture/SIH26168_High_Level_Architecture_Revision3.md, contracts/INTERFACE_SCHEMA_PLAN.md#I-20 and docs/PRIVATE_ARTIFACT_POLICY.md.

schema_version.description: Major schema version of the dataset manifest contract.

dataset_id.description: Immutable identifier for this private dataset revision. Never a filesystem path.

source_revision.description: Organizer-supplied label identifying the upstream source archive/revision this manifest was built from. Never a raw local or absolute path.

archive_hashes.description: SHA-256 digest of each immutable source archive, keyed by archive identifier (not a path). Hash-only reference per docs/PRIVATE_ARTIFACT_POLICY.md -- no raw bytes ever enter this manifest or Git.

file_hashes.description: SHA-256 digest of each individual extracted file, keyed by a relative-within-archive file identifier (never an absolute or local filesystem path).

schemas.description: Six-schema IO-VNBD validation allowlist entries actually present in this dataset revision. WP-10.2 owns allowlist enforcement; this field only records which allowlisted schemas this manifest covers.

units_status.description: Per-schema unit/conversion declaration. Unresolved units must be explicit and never guessed.

group_ids.description: Immutable duplicate/parent-session group identifiers. WP-10.3 owns the grouping algorithm; every included file must resolve to exactly one group_id.

splits.description: Group-to-split assignment. WP-10.4 owns leakage-safe split construction; a given group_id may appear in at most one split.

exclusions.description: Quarantined files/groups and the reason. Files failing schema, hash, unit or leakage checks are recorded here -- never silently dropped.

rights_status.description: Rights lineage classification per the S0 audit. Real IO-VNBD data may only ever be ORGANIZER_DIRECTED_CONDITIONAL; there is no bare 'approved' value.

privacy.description: Privacy handling class. A PRIVATE_OFFLINE_ONLY manifest's referenced archives/files must never leave the private offline workspace or enter Git/CI.

redistribution.description: Redistribution rights. Real IO-VNBD-derived datasets are always PROHIBITED absent an explicit organizer amendment.
